==Rules==

1. You must abide by [https://www.fandom.com/terms-of-use Fandom Terms of Use].

2. No disrepect, toxicity or hate to others, especially staff.

3. No nsfw language, pictures, etc.

4. No Spamming ... this includes creating long posts with spaces, repeatedly post, or copy-paste spam.

5. No advertising.

6. No griefing pages (inserting gibberish or fake stats).


Failure to abide by these rules will result in a warning or punishment depending on the action and context.
